items.scope: All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Snowflake products, including those of its subsidiaries, and vulnerabilities in third-party software that are discovered by, or reported to, Snowflake that are not within another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Netskope products and services.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.
JetBrains products only.
Synology issues only.
All Gallagher security products only.
StrongDM issues only.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Palantir products and technologies only.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Yandex issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Carrier Global products only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
Crafter CMS issues only.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
All issues related to Search Guard only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Toreon that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Synaptics issues only.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
